svg.title: Every one of the specimen's 1007 parameters, followed through training.
svg.desc: Time runs down the plate on a logarithmic scale (200 steps; AdamW, η 0.02 → 0.002 (warmup 20, cosine), β₂ 0.95, weight decay 0.01 on matrices, clip 1; seed 1). Each path is one parameter's displacement Δ = θᵢ(t) − θᵢ(0) from its random starting value, placed horizontally at asinh(Δ/δ) with δ = 0.2608 the median final displacement (linear near 0, logarithmic far out); every path starts on the centre line. The straight roof at the top is Adam's first update, which is sign descent: nearly every parameter moves by the same distance η₁ = 0.001 (weight decay and ε cause the small differences). In value ink: the 56 coordinates of the embedding E. Eight paths do not visibly leave the centre line: the key bias b_k, whose gradient is identically zero.
